source_name: Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (LRK) – open data export
what_it_contains: Every registered KDV, BSO, gastouderbureau and gastouder in NL with houder (operator) name, KvK number, address, registered child places, registration date, inspection status. Updated daily; CSV/XML download.
how_to_extract: Download the CSV export, filter opvangvorm = 'KDV', group by 'naam houder' / KvK number to compute locations and total kindplaatsen per operator, then join to KvK (Handelsregister) for board members and to LinkedIn for titles.

what_it_contains: Ranked list of the 100 largest NL childcare organisations (concern level) with locations, child places and market share, derived from LRK; quarterly editions incl. March and June 2026.
how_to_extract: Copy table from the page for each quarter; organisation pages on the same site give KvK numbers, addresses and location lists.

what_it_contains: PDF inspection reports per location naming the houder and often the location manager and parent-communication app in use.
how_to_extract: Search a location in LRK, open 'Inspectierapporten'; scrape PDFs for 'houder' and 'ouderapp' mentions.

source_name: KvK Handelsregister / Open Data Statistiek (SBI 88.911 kinderopvang)
what_it_contains: Legal entity, bestuurders (directors), addresses for all companies with SBI 88.911 (kinderopvang) and 88.912 (peuterspeelzalen).
how_to_extract: Use the KvK API (paid per call) or the free web search; filter by SBI 88911; export directors.

source_name: Opgroeien / Kind en Gezin – Zoek kinderopvang (Flanders & Brussels NL) + open data
what_it_contains: All licensed (vergunde) kinderopvang locations in Flanders and Dutch-speaking Brussels with organiser (organisator) name, capacity, subsidy tier (T1/T2/T3), address. Open datasets on data.vlaanderen.be / opgroeien.be.
how_to_extract: Download the open dataset 'Kinderopvanglocaties baby's en peuters' from https://www.opgroeien.be/kennis/cijfers-en-rapporten or the Vlaanderen open data portal; group by organiser (ondernemingsnummer) to compute size; join to KBO for administrators.

source_name: ONE – Office de la Naissance et de l'Enfance (Wallonia-Brussels) – Milieux d'accueil register
what_it_contains: Authorised crèches, MCAE, maisons d'enfants and co-accueil in Wallonia and French-speaking Brussels with 'pouvoir organisateur' (operator), address, capacity, subsidy status.
how_to_extract: Use the 'Trouver un milieu d'accueil' search and export per province; request the open data file from ONE (data available via Open Data Wallonie-Bruxelles, odwb.be, dataset 'Milieux d'accueil ONE').

source_name: KBO/BCE – Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises + Moniteur belge (NACE 88.91)
what_it_contains: Company/asbl records for NACE 88.91 (child day-care activities) with addresses; Moniteur belge annexes list administrators/directors.
how_to_extract: Filter by NACE 88.91 in KBO public search (or KBO open data files); look up ejustice.just.fgov.be for board appointments.

what_it_contains: All French EAJE (crèches, micro-crèches, multi-accueils) with gestionnaire name, capacity, address, type (PSU/PAJE), managed by CNAF.
how_to_extract: Use the search by commune/department and the 'gestionnaire' field; CNAF publishes EAJE datasets on data.caf.fr ('Établissements d'accueil du jeune enfant') downloadable as CSV.

what_it_contains: Datasets of EAJE establishments financed by CAF: gestionnaire, type of manager (public/associatif/entreprise), places, commune, year.
how_to_extract: Download the EAJE dataset CSV; group by gestionnaire to size operators; join to SIRENE by SIREN where provided.

source_name: SIRENE open data (INSEE) – NAF 88.91A Accueil de jeunes enfants
what_it_contains: Every French legal unit and establishment with NAF 88.91A (crèches, micro-crèches, haltes-garderies), including headcount band, creation date, address, SIREN/SIRET.
how_to_extract: Use annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr or the INSEE Sirene API with activitePrincipaleUniteLegale=88.91A; download the StockEtablissement CSV and filter; then use Pappers.fr / INPI RNE for dirigeants (legal representatives).

source_name: INPI Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) / Pappers.fr
what_it_contains: Official directors (dirigeants), financial statements, beneficial owners for crèche companies (e.g., Evancia, Grandir, La Maison Bleue).
how_to_extract: Search by company name or SIREN; the dirigeants tab lists names and roles; Pappers offers CSV export and API.

source_name: Fédération Française des Entreprises de Crèches (FFEC) member list
what_it_contains: Members list of private crèche companies (groups and SMEs) with websites.
how_to_extract: Scrape the 'Nos adhérents' page; cross-reference with SIRENE.

source_name: MENJE – Liste des services d'éducation et d'accueil (SEA) agréés / chèque-service accueil prestataires
what_it_contains: Ministry list of licensed crèches, foyers de jour, maisons relais and mini-crèches in Luxembourg with operator (gestionnaire), address, capacity and CSA participation.
how_to_extract: Download the PDF/Excel list of 'structures d'accueil agréées' from the MENJE page (also available on data.public.lu 'Services d'éducation et d'accueil'); group by gestionnaire.

source_name: data.public.lu – open data portal (structures d'accueil pour enfants)
what_it_contains: Open datasets of childcare structures (crèches, maisons relais) with geolocation and operator.
how_to_extract: Search 'crèche' or 'structures d'accueil'; download CSV/GeoJSON; join with LBR.

what_it_contains: Company records and managers (gérants/administrateurs) for crèche operators (SARL, asbl).
how_to_extract: Free search by name; download extracts (paid) for managers; NACE 88.91.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages / Sales Navigator (industry: Child Day Care Services)
what_it_contains: Current CEO / bestuurder / DG names, titles and headcount for each operator.
how_to_extract: Filter by industry 'Individual and Family Services' / keyword kinderopvang, crèche; geography FR/NL/BE/LU; titles CEO, Bestuurder, Directeur Général.
